FAQ

How do I create a shopping list by voice?

Open BuyVoice, tap the record button and speak naturally. You can say a whole sentence like "tomorrow I'm buying chicken, tomatoes and onions" and the app picks out each item and adds it to your list. There is nothing to type.

Is BuyVoice free?

Yes. The app is free and has no ads. There is an optional Premium subscription that unlocks photo digitisation and price estimates, and helps pay for maintenance and updates.

How many languages does the voice recognition understand?

Thirteen: English, Spanish, German, Italian, French, Turkish, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Hungarian, Japanese, Hindi and Dutch.

Can I share a list with my family?

Yes. Lists can be shared with family and friends so everyone sees the same list and it stays in sync while you shop.

Can I turn a handwritten list into a digital one?

Yes. Take a photo of a paper list and BuyVoice digitises it instantly. This is a Premium feature.

How do the price estimates work?

BuyVoice estimates what your list will cost in a given city — Zurich, New York and others — so you can plan your budget before you go. This is a Premium feature.
